structure_flags.label: bibliography / Gaiffas2007UniformInhomogeneous
structure_flags.one_line: The cited title is actually Gaiffas (2009), Statistica Sinica 19, 427–447; ESAIM: PS 11 (2007) is a different, pointwise-adaptation paper.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:math/0410354, corresponding to Mathematical Methods of Statistics 14 (2005)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a pointwise minimax rate at a regularly varying design zero through a one-point bias--information equation.

"Uniform estimation of a signal based on inhomogeneous data" is published in Statistica Sinica 19 (2009), 427--447 and studies spatially varying uniform risk with density zeros; it is not ESAIM: PS 11 (2007), 93--115.
The paper studies pointwise and uniform estimation and inference for a treatment-effect function along a continuous bivariate assignment boundary.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2510.26051, revised May 2026; journal version listed as Journal of Econometrics 256
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible preprint establishes uniform distributional approximations and minimax lower bounds for isotropic boundary estimators; the exact journal Theorem 6 formula and density condition remain source-verification items rather than grounds for a mismatch flag.
The paper concerns minimax learning of linear and nonlinear integrals over submanifolds under a nonparametric regression model, rather than pointwise recovery of an entire trace.
The generic band construction relies on Gaussian approximation, anti-concentration, and multiplier calibration and supplies honest asymptotic bands without requiring an extreme-value limit.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1110.4985, corresponding to Electronic Journal of Statistics 6 (2012)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Self-similarity is presented as necessary and sufficient for adaptive honest bands over the paper's smoothness classes.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear regression functionals over convex classes.
